'''''Han Solo in the Lair of the Space Slugs''''' was a [[holothriller]] about [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. This holothriller was one of many that featured him under a licensing deal he made with a [[Holoshow/Legends|holoshow]] producer.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
